title: 301. Palindrome Partitioning II

examples.explanation: Splitting as "aa" | "b" uses one cut and both parts are palindromes.
A single character is already a palindrome.

hints: Expand around every center to mark all palindromic substrings in O(n^2).
Let dp[i] be the min cuts for the prefix ending at i; extend from each palindrome start.
A single DP pass with center expansion avoids storing the full n x n table.
